SHARED-F-2-S139.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Router Integration
SHARED-F-2-S139.description: Expose consent capture and retrieval endpoints via FastAPI and integrate with tool_router to allow controlled invocation from LLM workflows, including validation through Pydantic models and enforcement hooks.

SHARED-F-2-S140.title: Consent Capture UX Flow Integration
SHARED-F-2-S140.description: Integrate consent prompts and tier selection into chat interaction flow, ensuring user-visible consent decisions are captured before any data persistence and aligned with unknown_question_service and lead capture flows.

SHARED-F-2-S141.title: Consent-Aware Debug Logging and Audit Trail
SHARED-F-2-S141.description: Enhance debug_logger and audit mechanisms to respect consent tier, ensuring no identifiable data is logged without Tier 2 consent and all consent decisions are traceable for compliance.

SHARED-F-2-S142.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
SHARED-F-2-S142.description: Integrate consent checks across shared domain services (lead_capture, unknowns, safety) to ensure all data-producing flows respect consent tier before storage or external calls.
